extDescription.message: Bilingual web page translation with your own LLM. One click, no tracking.

serviceNote.message: Plain Translate uses your own account with each service. Page text goes only to the service you choose, keys stay in this browser, and the service bills you at its standard rates.

keyHelpLocal.message: A model running on this computer usually needs no key.

modelsFailed.message: Could not load the model list ($P1$). You can still type a model name.

reasoningHint.message: Off starts fastest; translation seldom needs reasoning.

testOk.message: ✓ First word in $P1$ s, done in $P2$ s: $P3$

permissionDenied.message: Access to $P1$ was not granted, so translations cannot be sent there.

targetHint.message: The source language is detected automatically; paragraphs already in this language are skipped.

shortcutHint.message: "Not set" usually means another extension already uses the key. You can also click the toolbar icon and translate from its panel.

missingConfig.message: Choose a translation service and enter its API key in the settings first.

badAddress.message: Enter an address that starts with https:// or http://.

noSubtitles.message: This video has no subtitles to translate.

subtitlesInTarget.message: This video's subtitles are already in the language you read.

subtitlesUnavailable.message: YouTube did not return this video's subtitles.

youtubeSubtitlesNote.message: Turning this on asks Chrome for access to youtube.com so a bilingual subtitles button can appear in the player. Nothing is sent to your translation service until you turn on that button.

pageBlocked.message: Chrome doesn't let extensions run on this page.

keyRejected.message: $P1$ rejected the API key (HTTP 401). Click the Plain Translate toolbar icon to change it.
